dedupe_keys.name: matlab code and data for power flow constrained energy management of an ieee 33 bus pv battery microgrid

description: Shengjie Li publishes MATLAB code and data for an IEEE 33-bus photovoltaic and battery microgrid study. Zenodo lists a public ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The deposited description states that it contains MATLAB source, feeder data, photovoltaic, load and price curves, random seeds, numerical results, verification records and figures. The code can support tests of energy-management choices while checking distribution power-flow constraints. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Coverage is the IEEE 33-bus benchmark and supplied operating traces, not a measured feeder operated by a named utility. A limitation is that the brief public description does not state the objective function, battery degradation treatment, time step or solver version; the archive would need inspection before transferring numerical assumptions to another grid. The metadata language field says English, while the deposited description is Chinese. Neither code nor data were downloaded, and no dispatch or voltage result was reproduced.
